description: Rightful Empress of Terra? Perhaps. Master manipulator? Certainly. Nyota Uhura is as vengeful and power-hungry as the most ruthless of Terrans, though she is adept at hiding her sharp teeth behind a sweet smile. Like her Kelvin counterpart, she serves as a communications officer on the ISS Enterprise. But that is where the similarities end. Uhura believes in taking what she wants when she wants it. She does not, however, believe in gratuitous violence. She prefers to wield her power quietly. There is no need for daggers when she can simply blackmail those who stand against her. It is perhaps surprising, then, that Uhura has invested in the Arena; she would never lower herself to actually participate in the gladiatorial games. Why should she get her hands dirty battling with and against the masses? Instead, she is a silent partner in this burgeoning enterprise. It is a solid investment, after all, and what better way to keep track of the most powerful warriors in her own universe and beyond? There are alliances to be made and secrets to be found out. And Nyota Uhura is the perfect woman for the job.
